meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 你问某天的安排时，它会先读取共享授权说明，再获取当天的日历事件与未完成任务，并整理成中文摘要，列出日程表、待办清单、冲突提醒与空闲时段。
howto.when: 当用户想了解某日期范围的日程活动或未完成任务（通常指今天、明天或本周的安排），或要求生成早报/站会摘要时触发。

say.note: 会读取今天的日程并列出未完成任务摘要。
会一并汇总明天的日程和未完成任务。
输出本周日程、待办以及冲突提醒。

howto.what_en: When asked about a day's schedule and open tasks, Claude reads shared auth notes, fetches that date's calendar events and pending tasks, and outputs a summary with an agenda table, to-do list, conflicts, and free slots.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to see a certain day's schedule or outstanding to-dos (typically today, tomorrow, or this week), or asks for a standup/morning summary.

say_en.note: Returns today's agenda and open-task summary.

say_en.text: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
say_en.note: Also summarizes tomorrow's events and pending tasks.

say_en.text: Generate a standup report for this week
say_en.note: Lists the week's events, to-dos, and conflicts.
